query: How many sets of slick tyres can a driver use during a non-sprint race weekend in 2025?

ground_truth.section: Quantity, selection, and specification of tyres during a Competition
ground_truth.rationale: Article 30.2 limits a driver to thirteen dry-weather tyre sets at a non-sprint Competition.

query: How many sets of intermediate and wet tyres are allocated to each driver during a non-sprint weekend in 2023?

ground_truth.section: Quantity, selection and specification of tyres during a Competition
ground_truth.rationale: Article 30.2 sets four intermediate and three wet-weather tyre sets for a non-sprint Competition in 2023.

query: Which compound is mandatory for Q3 according to the 2025 sporting regulations?

ground_truth.section: Quantity, selection, and specification of tyres during a Competition
ground_truth.rationale: Article 30.2 defines the mandatory dry-weather Q3 specification as the softest available specification.

query: Is a driver required to use at least two different dry tyre compounds during the race in 2025?

ground_truth.rationale: Article 30.5m requires two different dry-weather specifications unless intermediate or wet-weather tyres were used.

query: What is the pit lane speed limit during a competition in 2025?

ground_truth.section: PIT ENTRY ROAD, PIT LANE AND PIT EXIT ROAD
ground_truth.rationale: Article 34.7 imposes an 80km/h speed limit in the pit lane during the Competition.

query: What penalty applies if a car is released from its pit stop under unsafe conditions during the race?

ground_truth.section: PIT ENTRY ROAD, PIT LANE AND PIT EXIT ROAD
ground_truth.rationale: Article 34.14d applies the Article 54.3d penalty to an unsafe release during a sprint or race.

query: Can a car enter the pit lane under Virtual Safety Car and for what purpose?

ground_truth.rationale: Article 56.4 allows pit entry during VSC only for changing tyres.

query: What message does the FIA send through the official system when the Safety Car is deployed?

ground_truth.rationale: Article 55.4 defines the message and the accompanying FIA panels and marshal-post signals.

query: What signal indicates the start of the Virtual Safety Car procedure in 2025?

ground_truth.rationale: Article 56.2 defines the VSC deployment message and the VSC light-panel signal.

query: What is communicated to the Competitors when the clerk of the course orders the deployment of the Safety Car in 2023?

ground_truth.rationale: Article 55.4 requires the deployment message, SC panels, and waved yellow flags in 2023.

query: What happens immediately when a race is suspended with the red flag in 2025?

ground_truth.rationale: Article 57.2 sets the immediate suspension procedure and the order in which cars enter the pit lane.

query: What time penalties can the FIA impose after an in-race incident?

ground_truth.section: INCIDENTS DURING THE SPRINT SESSION OR THE RACE
ground_truth.rationale: Article 54.3 lists the time and drive-through penalties available to the stewards.

query: Is a point awarded to the driver who sets the fastest lap of the race under the 2023 regulations?

ground_truth.rationale: Article 6.4 awards one point only when the fastest valid lap is set by a driver classified in the top ten.

query: When is DRS allowed to be activated after the race start or a Safety Car period in 2025?

ground_truth.rationale: Article 22.1c allows adjustable bodywork after one lap following the start or a Safety Car period.

query: How many laps must a driver complete after the start or a Safety Car before being allowed to use DRS in the 2023 race?

ground_truth.rationale: Article 22.1c required two laps after the start or a Safety Car period in the 2023 race.

query: What timing rule must drivers follow after the Safety Car is deployed?

expected_keywords: first and second safety car lines
ground_truth.rationale: Article 55.7 requires drivers to stay above the FIA ECU minimum time in each marshalling sector and at both Safety Car lines.

query: What are the exceptions to the no-overtaking rule while the Safety Car is on track in 2023?

expected_keywords: no driver may overtake another car
ground_truth.rationale: Article 55.8 lists the limited overtaking exceptions during a Safety Car intervention.

query: What happens if the Safety Car is still deployed on the last lap?

ground_truth.rationale: Article 55.17 ends the session normally at the end of the last lap without overtaking.

query: What speed constraint applies during a Virtual Safety Car period?

expected_keywords: FIA light panels change to green
ground_truth.rationale: Article 56.5 applies the FIA ECU minimum-time rule throughout the VSC procedure.

query: Where can overtaking occur during a Virtual Safety Car period?

ground_truth.rationale: Article 56.6 bans normal-track overtaking but lists pit-area and obvious-problem exceptions.

query: How does the FIA end the Virtual Safety Car procedure?

ground_truth.rationale: Article 56.7 defines the ending message, the 10-to-15-second transition, and the green panels.

ground_truth.rationale: Article 30.2 contains a Monaco-specific sprint allocation of three wet-weather sets.

query: What happens to an intermediate tyre set when a practice session is declared wet?

ground_truth.rationale: Article 30.5g requires one intermediate set to be returned after a wet practice session.

ground_truth.rationale: Article 55.4 specifies the light-panel and marshal-post signals that accompany the deployment message.

query: What conditions enable DRS during a 2024 race?

ground_truth.rationale: Article 22.1 requires the post-start lap condition and a gap of less than one second at a detection point.
